exposure: proportion of pediatric patients in daily practice
number of DDH cases treated per year
outcome: treatment preferences for DDH (e.g., bracing type, age limits for intervention, open reduction approach, intraoperative reduction checks)
cohort: Orthopedic surgeons in Turkiye responding to a nationwide survey regarding their management preferences for developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH) in cases under 1 year of age.
finding: Management preferences of orthopedic surgeons for DDH cases under 1 year of age are primarily influenced by their pediatric patient load and the volume of DDH cases they treat annually.
